operations.name: report.student.run
operations.purpose: Run a student or admission report from the catalogue.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No student and admission report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's student and admission group: Class and section roster; Student directory with guardian contacts; Current enrolment strength; New admissions in a period; Withdrawals and expulsions; Enrolment trend and retention; Inquiry pipeline and conversion rate; Applications pending review; Entry test schedule and results; Declined inquiries with reasons; Students with missing documents; Sibling and family groupings. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: academic_session_id
parameters.notes: The session the report covers (BR-2). Only where the request names one — the enrolment trend and a past session's admissions need it. Omitted, it is the open session (academic-session-scope).

parameters.name: class_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No class this reader may see matches.

parameters.notes: Where the report covers a class. A teacher is offered only their own (BR-3, A1, E3).

parameters.name: section_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No section this reader may see matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching sections with their class.

parameters.notes: Where the report covers a section. A teacher is offered only their own (BR-3, A1).

parameters.name: status
parameters.notes: Which students or inquiries the report covers (BR-2). It governs the result — a withdrawn student is not in an enrolled roster (E9).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: days_waiting
fields.description: On applications pending review: how long each has waited (BR-6).

fields.name: reasons
fields.description: On withdrawals and expulsions: each leaver's reason (BR-8).

fields.name: families
fields.description: On the family groupings: children grouped by family code (BR-4).

fields.name: conversion_rate
fields.description: On the pipeline: inquiries that became admissions, as a proportion.

errors.meaning: The reader does not hold the permission for this report.
A teacher asked for a class they do not teach.

errors.note: Shown empty and said so, rather than appearing to have failed.

errors.meaning: More rows match than can be shown.
errors.note: Paged, with narrower parameters suggested — never truncated silently.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-9).

planningRules.rule: A teacher gets the roster for their own class and section, and nothing wider (BR-3, A1, AC-1, AC-2).
Report applications pending with how long each has waited. An application nobody has looked at for three weeks is what the report exists to surface (BR-6, A3, AC-4).
Report every leaver with their reason. The reason is what tells a family moving house from a disciplinary decision (BR-8, A5, AC-5).
Where the reader asks about families, group by family code rather than listing children — billing is per household (BR-4, A2, AC-6).
Never widen the status to lengthen a list. It governs who is in the result; an enrolled roster holds no withdrawn child (BR-2, E9, AC-7).
Say what the directory is before it is run for export. It is a complete contact list of every family at the school, and nothing restricts taking it away beyond the record that it was taken (OQ-1).
On declined inquiries, say that the reason shown may be the one recorded internally rather than the one the family was given. The two are not distinguished (OQ-4).
Never correct anything from a report. A wrong record is corrected where it is held (BR-10, E7, AC-8).
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure, and a paged one as paged — suggest a narrower period or scope rather than presenting the first page as the whole.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-9, BR-11).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session, and the academic session from the request only where it names one. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone (BR-5).

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-9).
